name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Jazan refinery hit 26 Nov; Hodeidah strikes
summary: Projectile hits Saudi Jazan refinery on 26 Nov, killing one; coalition strikes Houthi launch site in Hodeidah
state: An aerial projectile hit Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery on 26 Nov, killing a Nepali worker, injuring several and halting some operations; the Saudi-led coalition blamed the Houthis and said it destroyed a missile launch platform in Hodeidah (Al Jazeera). On 25 Nov the Houthis claimed attacks on Jeddah and Jazan ports, and the coalition said it intercepted eight drones, four over Ras Tanura (Xinhua). Cross-border strikes on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and neighbouring countries, which may change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation: cross-border Houthi–Saudi strikes on energy sites
